key_text_evidence.title: Belt Drift (Belt Misalignment)
key_text_evidence.excerpt: Belt Drift (Belt Misalignment) Root Cause: Off-centre loading (feeder से coal belt के center में नहीं गिर रही), worn idlers, wet/sticky coal जो एक तरफ build-up कर रही हो, misaligned pulleys, या incorrect take-up tension।

key_text_evidence.title: Belt Drift — क्यों होती है, क्यों ख़तरनाक है?
key_text_evidence.excerpt: Belt drift → Belt का edge steel structure से contact → Friction heat generate → Coal dust ignite → FIRE।

key_text_evidence.title: Why the Belt Drifts (Misalignment)
key_text_evidence.excerpt: A drifted belt that contacts the steel structure can generate enough heat through friction to ignite coal dust — causing a conveyor fire.

key_text_evidence.title: Belt Alignment Along Structure
key_text_evidence.excerpt: Belt drift → edge contact with structure → friction heat → fire risk.

key_text_evidence.title: Transfer Point पर क्या गलत हो सकता है?
key_text_evidence.excerpt: Spillage | Belt overloading, worn skirt seals, off-centre loading | Structure पर coal गिरती है, idler damage, fire risk;
